newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Cosco Pacific shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Cosco Pacific shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of container leasing and terminal operating group COSCO Pacific Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
Shares of COSCO Pacific rose HK$0.65 or 4.3 percent to end at HK$15.80 on Thursday on volume of 19.49 million shares.
Brokers said there were rumours that the company's parent might raise its stake in Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd, whose shares were suspended on Thursday.
The company's parent, COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, currently holds five percent of the bank.

COSCO Pacific had also said earlier it was considering buying assets from its parent, including property and hotel projects in Hong Kong and in China, a coal-fire power plant, toll highway, hydro-electric power plant, and toll bridge.
